    Select download options

    To download resources, go to the new Resource Hub. To download the foundational skills, visit Foundation skills.

    Levels

    3. Select file type*

    4. Select export options*

    Note, machine-readable CSV files are plain text only. Refer to the curriculum webpages or other export options to see rich-text formatting, including for mathematical equations and some language features in the elaborations.

    Also note, when downloading curriculum content with connections, missing curriculum content indicates that these connections are not yet available for the selected curriculum(s).
